I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and rendering are unchecked.

- **Contents:** The page has the four-link top nav with "Overview" current, the "Overview" heading, the four stat tiles and the "Recent activity" card with five items. All of it uses your exact wording.
- **Design rules:** The tokens from `tokens.css` are copied inline so the file stands alone, and every color, size and spacing value comes from them. The layout follows `DESIGN.md`: a 64px nav, a 1120px centered column and 52px list rows.
- **Primary action:** `DESIGN.md` wants one primary button at the top right of the page. I left it out because you said to use exactly this content, and a button would need extra text. If you want one, I can add it.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available as files here. The text falls back to `system-ui` unless those fonts are installed on the machine.
